verdict.rationale: Gazebo is an open-source robotics simulator and set of C++ libraries that runs locally or on the user's own servers (headless server, GUI, transport). An AI-training opt-out control is a privacy axis for hosted or AI services that ingest user data, so it is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Gazebo collecting user data or offering any AI-training setting that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
